Hi Suzanne — thanks for the context and the attachment. Yes, we can absolutely consolidate into a single workshop. Two quick suggestions that have helped other customers keep those sessions actionable:

- 90 minutes total with a 60-minute redline walkthrough, then a 20-minute evidence/owners breakout and a 10-minute next-steps alignment.
- Ask BrightField to send a 1–2 item priority list (top 5 clauses max) so we can make sure legal time is used efficiently.

My availability (PT):
- Option A: Mon 7/19 09:00–10:30
- Option B: Tue 7/20 10:30–12:00
- Option C: Wed 7/21 13:00–14:30 (if afternoons are easier)

If one of those works, we’ll send a calendar invite and a short prep one-pager for attendees. I’m looping Hannah (on onboarding playbook/evidence) and Laura (legal ops) to make sure we have the right evidence owners and the meeting agenda.

I’ve attached a short playbook we use for these sessions: onboard-playbook.pdf (stub).

Quick Q: do you want us to run the workshop as a hybrid (shared screen + breakout Google doc) or would you prefer we keep it as a legal-only call and follow up with an operations meeting?

Best,
So
